purpose: Sub-job of j009 (2x2 source-composition screen: far-source weight in {0.5, 1} x near term in {0, 0.5}) on walker2d-kinematic-thighjnt-medium. Registered in research/PLAN.md (auto-loop) before submission; requested by the user on 2026-11-21.

rule.metric: Last5 = mean of the last five evaluation points, 10 episodes each (V21/j004-j008 metric)
rule.strong_control: per task, the group among T, BC, BCMIX with the highest Last5 mean over seeds 3121-3125
rule.screen_effective: candidate (BCMIXN) minus strong control, paired by seed: mean > 0 and mean > 1 * paired SE
rule.supported: screen-effective on at least 2 of the 3 tasks (j009a/b/c combined) -> a confirmation job with 5 never-used seeds per task on those tasks
rule.rejected: paired mean difference <= 0 on at least 2 of the 3 tasks
rule.factorial_registered_secondary: not counted by the loop: near term helps if near_at_far1 and near_at_far05 are both > 0 and > 1 SE on a task; far weight hurts on walker medium if BCMIX-W50 < 0 and BCMIXN-W50N < 0 there, each beyond 1 SE
rule.descriptive: 2 * SE criterion, candidate minus BCMIX / BC / T, all 2x2 effects and the interaction, W50N vs strong control on every task, near-set size, episode lengths
rule.note: Rules are fixed before results; not changed after results are seen. The verdict is made only after all three sub-jobs finish; if any sub-job fails, no verdict.

candidate_settings.near_set: source rows with standardized-state nearest distance to target states <= tau; tau = 90% quantile of target leave-one-trajectory-out nearest distances (exactly the rows j005 CG90 removed, the near set of j007)
candidate_settings.loss: mean BC over 64 target rows + a * mean BC over 64 uniform source rows + b * mean BC over 32 near rows
